# UIScriptEditorComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Code editor of a script UI with JavaScript highlighting; the callback gets the text whenever it changes.

## Methods

### background {#background}

::: member

Shows or hides the dark background and border.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `background` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether they are drawn |

**Returns** [`UIScriptEditorComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIScriptEditorComponent) — this editor

:::

::: member

| --- | --- | --- |
| `padding` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | space in pixels |

**Returns** [`UIScriptEditorComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIScriptEditorComponent) — this editor

:::
